titleZh: 又過一天，又賺一份工錢

meaning.zh: 又完成了一天例行工作，賺取生活所需；語氣常帶疲倦或無奈。
meaning.en: Another routine day of work has brought another day’s pay, often said with weariness or resignation.

model.zh: 阿朗又做完一班幾乎一模一樣的工作，收好工具後苦笑了一下。
model.en: After another nearly identical shift, Long packed up his tools and said, “Another day, another dollar.”

picture.zh: 日曆翻過一頁，工作簿又添上一筆工錢。
picture.en: A calendar page turns; a pay ledger gains one more entry.

boundary.zh: 不只表示「明天會賺一元」，也不是興奮宣告發大財。
boundary.en: It is not a literal promise of one dollar tomorrow, nor a triumphant announcement of wealth.

where.zh: 適合下班或開始又一個重複工作日的閒談；對別人遇到裁員時不宜輕率使用。
where.en: Use it casually after a shift or at the start of another familiar workday; avoid using it lightly around job loss.

tone.zh: 口語、自嘲或疲倦；偶爾可帶平靜的接受。
tone.en: Colloquial, wry, or tired; sometimes a quiet acceptance of routine.

checks.zh: 說話者的語氣是否無奈或平靜？
checks.en: Is the tone weary or matter-of-fact?

checks.zh: 我有否誤解 dollar 的字面金額？

readAloud.zh: 她關掉店裏的燈，望着又填滿一頁的工作紀錄。
readAloud.en: She switched off the shop lights and looked at another full page of work records: “Another day, another dollar.”

prompt.zh: 同事下班時說這句，最可能是甚麼語氣？

options.zh: 對又一日例行工作的疲倦或自嘲。

options.reasonZh: 符合這句話常見的口語語氣。

prompt.zh: 員工完成又一天相同的盤點工作。哪句自然？

options.zh: 「又做完一日盤點；又過一天，又賺一份工錢。」

options.zh: 「今天中了彩票；又過一天，又賺一份工錢。」
